{{Quote|Hello there.|Obi-Wan Kenobi greeting Separatist forces on the core ship|<ref name="Episode III" />}}
A converted '''core ship''' served as the command center for the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems]]'s operations on the occupied [[planet]] of [[Utapau]]. During the [[Battle of Utapau]], [[Jedi General]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi]] confronted Confederate [[General]] [[Grievous]] in the [[core ship]]. Shortly into their [[lightsaber duel]], the [[212th Attack Battalion]] suddenly attacked the [[battle droid]]s stationed in the [[Starship|ship]], convincing Grievous to flee on his [[TSMEU-6 personal wheel bike]].<ref name="Episode III" />
